title: Free Spotlight is its own builder page, with a clock and a what's-next card

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-19 (project thread: Build four feature launch funnels): four builder pages (Free Spotlight, Create a Space, Launch Your Website, Email Marketing), each its own feature, wired to the real feature, a light timer challenge, each finish inviting the next without forcing it. Decision card 20:27Z: Free Spotlight builds the PERSONAL Spotlight, with a Space offered next. Pin rewrite of free-spotlight-entry approved on the card "Yes, update all of them".

detail: Ships the shared feature builder (components/frequency/site/pages/feature-builder, lib/feature-builder) and its first page. /free-spotlight asks three things (name, one line, main link) beside a live phone preview, races a 3-minute clock that starts on the first keystroke and counts bonus time past it, and keeps the draft in the browser until the finish. A member saves straight onto their profile (savePersonalSpotlight, the one profile writer) and the Spotlight is switched on and published; a visitor continues with Google or a magic link (the existing sign-in doors), the draft waits in an httpOnly hold cookie, and /finish/spotlight saves it once they are signed in and lands on ?done=1. The finish names the build time and offers the next open builders and Launch Your Business beside "I'm done for now". The catalog (lib/feature-builder/catalog.ts) lists all four; the cards only offer builders whose pages exist (open). The /free-spotlight redirect to the business builder is gone.

verify.note: Fails while /free-spotlight is missing or redirected, or the builder does not save and publish the personal Spotlight.
